{{Quote|It's good to see you, Four-Two.|RC-1138, to Delta 42|<ref name="SW:RC" />}}
'''Delta 42''' was [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad's]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who gave them various air support and extractions. They helped Delta Squad out of an exploding [[Core ship/Legends|Core ship]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="SW:RC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Four-Two's dead? That's...a shame. He served the Republic well|01/425 to Boss, from a scene cut from the game|<ref name="SW:RC" />}}
This clone pilot was originally going to have a relatively larger role in the game, namely, he would be Delta Squad's pilot during a ship crash on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] that was cut from the game. His corpse could be found in the game files.

During regular gameplay, a line from [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]] during Kashyyyk campaign while fighting [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], is "That's for Delta 23! Or was it 32?"<ref name="SW:RC" /> He is mentioning that this is revenge for 42's death after the cut ship crash, and may have accidentally been left in the game.
